consequence.statement: New feature (ArtifactGenerator for source composition/decomposition). The release notes do not describe any effect on existing configurations.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds a new ArtifactGenerator feature that supports source composition and decomposition patterns.

decision.reason: [ev-6ecafebffa71] lists ArtifactGenerator only as a new capability under "Overview of the new features". It says nothing about existing configurations failing, being rejected, being ignored or needing migration, so no failure kind is supported. If an operator does nothing, the new capability simply goes unused, so "none" (informational) fits. Confidence is low because the excerpt does not say outright that the feature has no effect on existing setups.
